Sophie — great to hear the uplift is coming. Happy to map out three practical paths and a recommended play that minimizes finance churn: 

1) One-off prorated invoice (fastest): charge for the exact uplift months pro-rated from activation date. No smoothing, no discount.

2) Staged billing (recommended for predictable spend): split the uplift into N monthly invoices (we can do 3 or 6 installments) with a capped overage threshold. This smooths the budget impact and is easy for procurement to approve.

3) Invoice smoothing + co-term amendment (preferred if you want a single recurring commitment): we can amortize the uplift across remaining contract months and co-term to Dec 31; offers a modest blended-rate discount for the predictability. Requires a short amendment and a 4–6 week lead time for capacity and pricing alignment.

Discount signal: we typically make modest concessions on price for longer commitment to the uplift (e.g., 5–10% blended discount depending on term and total uplift). Exact bands depend on annualized uplift and commit length — happy to propose a specific band once you confirm whether you prefer staged billing or smoothing.

I attached a short draft proposal (proposal_v1.pdf) that shows the staged billing example (3-month split) and a blended-smoothing example that co-terms to 2027-12-31. If you like the smoothing path I can generate a DocuSign amendment.

Next steps: tell me which of the three approaches looks closest to your procurement appetite and we’ll formalize numbers.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Looping in Priyom — a few internal notes for pricing: 

- If Vireo commits to co-term + 12 months of the uplifted level, we can offer ~10% blended concession; if they want a short 3–6 month smoothing only, target 5–7%.
- Confirm whether SLA/priority burst is required (that changes unit pricing).
- Margin check: staged billing is easiest operationally and keeps cashflow neutral; smoothing reduces near-term cash but increases retention signal — justify deeper discount only with longer commit.
